evidence: The black region is one connected, hole-free, nearly fourfold-rotationally symmetric structure within the supplied 4.7 um square footprint.
Each cardinal side has a narrow straight rectangular lead of approximately 0.23 um width and approximately 0.55 um length.
Each lead opens into a smooth convex petal, reaching approximately 0.92 um transverse width before the four petals overlap into a filled central crossing.
topology_reasoning.operation: A broad, symmetric central crossing region adiabatically expands each input guide and routes light through the orthogonal intersection before returning to the narrow output guide.

function_defining_knobs.lead_length: length of each straight external lead
function_defining_knobs.petal_length: longitudinal extent of each adiabatic expanded region
function_defining_knobs.max_petal_width: maximum multimode width of a petal
function_defining_knobs.center_waist_width: width at the inner end of each petal, controlling central overlap

topology_reasoning.implementation_plan: Extrude a straight gf.Path using a smooth, parameterized width function for one horizontal arm profile, assemble horizontal and 90-degree-rotated copies under @gf.cell, and rely on their union for the filled central crossing.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only smooth sine-petal profile: two orthogonal gf.Path extrusions with 0.236 um leads, 0.548 um lead lengths, 1.802 um petal spans, and 0.928 um maximum petal widths.
